spots.name: Emigrant Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Mount Tenabo
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,725 m (8,941 ft).

spots.name: Argenta WMA
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 148 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L21209548.
